title: 第5章  易感期？！
slug: 穿成星际废雌捡漏sss级兽夫赢麻了
content_zh:
姜知夏连忙摇头，再三发誓自己乖的很。
姜淮半信不信，敷衍点头：“没事，你哪次闯祸我不给你兜底，真有什么事你就往我身上推，二哥替你挡。”
姜知夏感动了，凑过去抱住他胳膊晃：“我就知道二哥最好了！”
姜淮愣了一下。
不知道从什么时候开始妹妹性格变的越来越孤僻，已经很久没和自己这么亲近。
像现在这样抱着他胳膊软声软气地说话，都是小时候的事了。
他唇角勾起一点弧度，心情非常好。
悬浮车在别墅门口停下。
姜知夏跳下车，不死心的举起礼盒，“二哥，这水晶真的不能退吗？”
“这种东西概不退换，你拿着自己用吧。”
姜淮说完就看到了妹妹垮下来的小脸。
哦对，她的精神力连激活水晶都够呛。
他表示同情：“你当个装饰品玩吧。”
姜知夏目送二哥的悬浮车唰一下飞走，认命地转身回家。
时间已经是半夜了，别墅里一片漆黑。
她关门转身，吓的一个激灵。
陆决就站在不远处，用那双灰蓝眼睛望着她。
姜知夏困惑：他站在这儿干嘛？
借着月光，她看到了对方头顶不知道什么时候冒出一双狼耳，扑簌簌抖动。
这时候的姜知夏，对陆决有着深深的忠诚护卫滤镜，再加上他身上大片大片的伤，不由自主降低了警惕，甚至往前一步问。

“你的耳朵怎么——啊！”
她万万没想到的是，陆决突然踉跄了两步，朝自己倒了过来！
姜知夏被扑倒在地还是懵的，后背抵在地上，对方滚烫的躯体压了上来！
“你干什么？！”
姜知夏挣扎起来，这才警铃大作！
她后知后觉意识到自己做了件蠢事——居然任由一个成年男人和自己单独共处一室！
她心里大骂自己脑子有坑，为了偷偷养他还把侍卫都遣散了，却没想过人家是女主的忠心侍卫，不是她的！
她挣扎的那点力气，在雄性兽人绝对的力量面前不值一提！
“陆决！你，你想干什么？你放开我，我都答应你！”
她大喊，陆决毫无反应，只紧紧的压着她压，喉咙里发出压抑的低喘。
“咔——”
是止咬器被牙齿研磨的声音！
姜知夏吓麻了！
幸亏没给他取这东西，这要是取下来，不得一口咬断她的脖子！
“陆决！你恩将仇报啊你！”她吓的声音都哽咽了。
呜呜，怎么女主面前他心甘情愿当备胎，轮到她了就变成白眼狼！
可能是她挣扎的太剧烈，陆决又用了几分力气和她的身躯紧密相贴。
姜知夏被烫的忍不住瑟缩了一下。
他怎么这么烫？
……等会儿，难道是易感期？！

她想到了这个被自己忽略的事。
这个世界雄性的精神力攻击性极强，这种攻击性每隔一段时间会转化成强烈的性欲，食欲，或者更强烈的暴虐，持续1-3天，被称之为易感期。
易感期的雄性，如果没有雌性安抚，很容易精神紊乱，最严重的情况会永久兽化，变成毫无理智的野兽。
陆决现在是易感期？！
姜知夏欲哭无泪。
她精神力弱的可怜，安抚不了他啊！
陆决在一片燥热与混乱中沉浮，这次的易感期来的突然，拼尽全力才保存一丝理智。
他隐约察觉到自己在做什么，但停不下来。
这个雌性身上散发的香气，诱使他控制不住的靠近，想将她揉碎在身体里。
娇小柔软的雌性浑身颤抖，被他按在身下无助的哭喊叫骂。
“你个白眼狼！混蛋！松手！呜呜……”
他去嗅她的脸，蹭她的眼泪。
好香……
尚存的一丝理智让他明白，自己在做的事会让这个雌性生气。
她会杀了他吧。
……能解脱了吗？太好了。
姜知夏抖着手摸索手腕上的光脑。
她要杀了陆决。
兽人沦为奴隶之后，身上会被种植一种芯片，奴隶芯片的控制权在主人手里，如果奴隶反抗，主人随时可以让芯片炸开奴隶的心脏！
小命当前，她顾不得什么计划，只想解决掉他。

“唔……”
耳边突然传来一声痛苦的呜咽，颈侧有一片湿热漫开。
姜知夏不可置信：哭了？！
不是，我哭是怕你弄死我，你个行凶的哭什么哭？
在她要炸开芯片的瞬间，恰巧看到了少年满脸痛苦的神色。
那双浑浊的灰蓝色眼睛盛满泪水，一片绝望。
姜知夏愣住了。
“……妈的！”
她一边在内心咒骂自己心软个什么劲儿，一边手脚并用一把抱住陆决，开始拼命调动微乎其微的精神力。
陆决浑身一震，急促的呼吸了几下，渐渐缓和下来，无意识低头亲昵的蹭着她颈侧。
怀里的身躯软了下来。
过了很久，陆决才无措的将昏迷的雌性揽在怀里。
刚才那一瞬间炸开的香气……是什么？
为什么他躁动的精神力仅凭着这股气味就被安抚下来？
还有，她……为什么没杀了他？
姜知夏昏昏沉沉，梦到了一片虚无的空间。
空间中央，开着一朵莹白的花。
小白花没有枝叶，孤零零地悬在半空，花瓣边缘泛着极淡的银光。
花的周围萦绕着一股特殊的香气，让姜知夏莫名觉得亲近，忍不住想凑近细看。
可刚凑近，就被一道无形的屏障挡住了。

小白花轻轻抖了抖花瓣。
姜知夏：“……”
是她的错觉吗？她怎么觉得这花在委屈巴巴地对她喊饿？！
她困惑地站在原地。
小白花似乎生气了，更加剧烈的抖了两下。
眼前忽然天旋地转……
姜知夏从梦中抽离，睁开了眼。
看到头顶炫彩夺目的水晶灯，她还有点懵。
下一秒惊恐的一骨碌翻身爬起，却发现自己在卧室里的大床上。
一扭头，和一双浑浊的眼睛四目相对。
陆决跪在床边，姿态恭顺。
听到她醒了立刻低下头，头顶那对银灰色的狼耳微微抖动。
姜知夏迟疑了一下。
是他把自己带到卧室的？
她试探着开口：“你好点了吗？”
陆决戴着止咬器，说不了话，沉默着点点头。
姜知夏看他乖顺的姿态，松了口气。
看来昨晚是因为易感期才没有理智，攻击自己不是他的本意。
“咕——”
突兀的声音响起，房间里安静了几秒。

姜知夏看向陆决的肚子。
大狼狗的脑袋垂的更低了。
content_en:
Jiang Zhixia shook her head quickly and swore again and again that she was very good.
Jiang Huai half believed it or not, and nodded perfunctorily: "It's okay. I won't tell you the truth whenever you get into trouble. If anything happens, just push it on me. My second brother will block it for you."
Jiang Zhixia was moved and moved over to hug his arm and shake her: "I knew that second brother was the best!"
Jiang Huai was stunned for a moment.
I don’t know when my sister started to become more and more withdrawn. It has been a long time since she was so close to me.
Holding his arm and talking softly like this was only a matter of childhood.
The corners of his lips curved a little, and he was in a very good mood.
The hover car stopped at the door of the villa.
Jiang Zhixia jumped out of the car and raised the gift box without giving up, "Second brother, is it true that this crystal cannot be returned?"
"This kind of thing cannot be returned or exchanged, just take it and use it yourself."
After Jiang Huai finished speaking, he saw his sister's slumped face.
Oh yes, her mental power is enough to even activate the crystal.
He expressed sympathy: "You can just play it as a decoration."
Jiang Zhixia watched the hover car that sent her second brother flying away, and turned around to go home resignedly.
It was already midnight and the villa was dark.
She closed the door and turned around, shocked.
Lu Jue was standing not far away, looking at her with his gray-blue eyes.
Jiang Zhixia was confused: Why is he standing here?
Through the moonlight, she saw a pair of wolf ears popping out of the other person's head, fluttering and trembling.
At this time, Jiang Zhixia had a deep loyal guard filter towards Lu Jue. Coupled with the large wounds on his body, he couldn't help lowering his vigilance and even took a step forward to ask.
"What's wrong with your ears-ah!"
What she never expected was that Lu Jue suddenly staggered two steps and fell towards her!
Jiang Zhixia was still stunned after being thrown to the ground. Her back was on the ground, and the other party's hot body pressed up against her!
"What are you doing?!"
Jiang Zhixia struggled, and then the alarm bell went off!
She belatedly realized that she had done something stupid - she actually allowed an adult man to be alone in the same room with her!
She cursed in her heart that she was out of her mind and had dismissed all the guards in order to secretly support him, but she never thought that he was the heroine's loyal guard, not hers!
The little strength she struggled with was nothing compared to the absolute power of the male orc!
"Lu Jue! You, what do you want to do? Let me go and I will promise you!"
She yelled, but Lu Jue didn't respond. He only pressed her tightly, and a low gasp came from his throat.
"Click——"
It’s the sound of the bite stopper being ground by teeth!
Jiang Zhixia was so scared!
Fortunately, he didn't take this thing out for him. If he took it off, he wouldn't bite her neck off!
"Lu Jue! You will repay kindness with revenge!" Her voice was so frightened that she choked with sobs.
Wow, why is he willing to be a spare tire in front of the heroine, but when it's her turn, he turns into a white-eyed wolf!
Maybe she was struggling too fiercely, so Lu Jue used a little more strength to keep close contact with her body.
Jiang Zhixia couldn't help but wince when she was so hot.
Why is he so hot?
...Wait a moment, is it the susceptible period? !
She thought about this thing that she had ignored.
Males in this world are extremely mentally aggressive, and this aggression will turn into strong sexual desire, appetite, or more intense violence every once in a while, lasting 1-3 days, which is called the susceptible period.
Males in the susceptible period, if not comforted by females, can easily become mentally disturbed. In the most serious cases, they will become permanently bestial and become irrational beasts.
Lu Jue is now in a susceptible period? !
Jiang Zhixia felt like crying but had no tears.
She is mentally weak and unable to comfort him!
Lu Jue was ups and downs in the heat and chaos. This vulnerable period came suddenly, and he tried his best to preserve his sanity.
He was vaguely aware of what he was doing, but he couldn't stop.
The fragrance exuding from this female body tempted him to get closer uncontrollably, wanting to crush her into his body.
Petite and soft femaleXing was trembling all over, crying and cursing helplessly as he held her down.
"You white-eyed wolf! Bastard! Let go! Wuwu..."
He sniffed her face and rubbed her tears.
It smells so good...
The remaining shred of reason made him understand that what he was doing would make the female angry.
She will kill him.
...Can you be freed? Very good.
Jiang Zhixia shook her hands and fumbled for the optical brain on her wrist.
She wanted to kill Lu Jue.
After an orc becomes a slave, a chip will be planted on his body. The control of the slave chip is in the hands of the master. If the slave resists, the master can let the chip explode the slave's heart at any time!
With her life at stake, she didn't care about any plans, she just wanted to get rid of him.
"Well..."
A painful whimper suddenly came from his ears, and a damp heat spread on the side of his neck.
Jiang Zhixia was in disbelief: Are you crying? !
No, I'm crying because I'm afraid you'll kill me. Why are you crying, you murderer?
Just when she was about to explode the chip, she happened to see the pained expression on the young man's face.
Those cloudy gray-blue eyes were filled with tears and despair.
Jiang Zhixia was stunned.
"...Damn it!"
While cursing herself for being so soft-hearted, she hugged Lu Jue with her arms and legs and began to desperately mobilize her little mental power.
Lu Jue was shocked all over, took a few rapid breaths, and gradually relaxed, unconsciously lowering his head and rubbing the side of her neck intimately.
The body in his arms softened.
After a long time, Lu Jue helplessly held the unconscious female in his arms.
What was that aroma that exploded just now?
Why was his restless mental energy soothed just by this smell?
Also, why didn't she kill him?
Jiang Zhixia was drowsy and dreamed of a void space.
In the center of the space, a bright white flower bloomed.
The small white flower has no branches and leaves, hanging alone in the air, with a very faint silver light on the edges of the petals.
There was a special fragrance lingering around the flowers, which made Jiang Zhixia feel inexplicably close to them and couldn't help but want to get closer and take a closer look.
But as soon as he got closer, he was blocked by an invisible barrier.
The little white flower shook its petals gently.
Jiang Zhixia: "..."
Is it her imagination? Why did she feel that this flower was complaining to her that she was hungry? !
She stood confused.
The little white flower seemed angry and shook even more violently.
Suddenly the world in front of me was spinning...
Jiang Zhixia pulled away from her dream and opened her eyes.
She was still a little confused when she saw the dazzling crystal lamp above her head.
The next second, he rolled over in horror, only to find himself on the big bed in the bedroom.
Turning his head, he met a pair of cloudy eyes.
Lu Jue knelt beside the bed, his posture submissive.
When he heard that she was awake, he immediately lowered his head, and the pair of silver-gray wolf ears on top of his head twitched slightly.
Jiang Zhixia hesitated.
Was he the one who brought him to the bedroom?
She tentatively said, "Are you feeling better?"
Lu Jue was wearing a bite arrester and couldn't speak, so he nodded silently.
Seeing his obedient posture, Jiang Zhixia breathed a sigh of relief.
It seems that he was irrational last night because of his susceptible period, and attacking himself was not his original intention.
"Gu——"
A sudden sound sounded, and the room was quiet for a few seconds.
Jiang Zhixia looked at Lu Jue's belly.
The big wolfdog's head hung lower.
